comparison.objective: Compress two retaining legs and insert a cage fastener through a plate while steadying the plate; not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained compression, aligned insertion, and release-triggered expansion versus hex-key engagement, collar rotation, and iterative dynamic calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Legs must expand behind the plate before both grippers release. Numeric seating/compression tolerances are not stated. Candidate instead requires two safe carriage stops and post-lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization, but the central tested mechanics—compliant snap insertion versus adjustable damping—are different.
